headline: Markets closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada; Sensex, Nifty ended last session higher above key levels

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: NSE and BSE are closed today on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.
In the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices gained supported by banking and pharmaceutical stocks.
A correction in crude oil prices boosted market sentiment in the previous session.
RBI queried bank valuations regarding certain bond derivative trades.
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed today, November 10, for the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday.
On the last trading day, Sensex surpassed 81,000 while Nifty settled above the 25,000 mark.
Data Patterns gained 9% during the previous trading session.
Crude oil prices declined after comments downplaying escalation risk with Iran.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today on account of Diwali-Balipratipada. In the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty extended gains to close at multi-month highs, supported by banking and pharma stocks. Data Patterns surged 9% in the previous session.
